title: Decimal-valued expires bypasses _numeric_value and resurrects expired drop at DEFAULT_TTL
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py:148-152,174-180. Codec _validate_field_type accepts Decimal as num so hand-built/add_drop records legitimately carry it; isinstance(int,float) check misses -> falls to DEFAULT_TTL violating no-resurrection invariant this bead established. Wire path safe (CBOR tags rejected). Fix: accept Decimal in _numeric_value or reject Decimal expires explicitly.
close_reason: _numeric_value now accepts finite Decimal (codec-admitted num type), converting via float() and clamping beyond-float-range values to +/-inf; non-finite Decimals rejected to None like bools/non-numerics. Decimal past-expires drops can no longer resurrect at DEFAULT_TTL. Regression tests: decimal future-remaining, decimal past-no-resurrection (listing empty + storage count 0), NaN-Decimal -> default-ttl observation via raw CBOR oracle. Wire path unchanged (CBOR tags still rejected at _decode_single_cbor). tests/coap -k deaddrop: 71 passed.
